acceptanceCriteria: A test kills the producer group mid-git-read and asserts no git child outlives it (or Close waits for them)
worksource children are either in the producer's group or tracked and reaped by Close
body: Lane flake-1021j (PR #1462, V1-0638) found that worksource starts git children in their own process groups, so killing the producer's group does not reach them; they can outlive the producer and race run.Close / scratch cleanup. Pre-existing; not observed failing. Also seen: SIGSTOP of a git child between fork and setpgid could not be resumed by a group SIGCONT.
title: worksource: git children run in their own process groups and survive a producer SIGKILL, racing run.Close
